verification_level: FAST plus BATCH plus the five affected SSL member-buffer/member-slot adversarial probes. Seven files audited, one deferred (store_meth.rs, a retained loader/callback boundary), two low-severity latent-bound repairs, two caller-contract clarifications, no UB, no ABI regression and no hidden obligation.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt: the handshake state machine, the TLS1.2 key schedule and record protection, the signature-algorithm/max-fragment-length surface, the deprecated ENGINE/temporary-DH setters, and the timestamping print helpers. src/store/store_meth.rs was deferred NOT_RUN because it is a genuine store-loader/callback dispatch boundary, already excluded as retained by earlier sweeps.

defects.description: The module header said ossl_statem_send_fatal does not send an alert, while the body sends the two alert bytes through ssl3_write_bytes whenever a write BIO is installed. The header was corrected to describe the implemented behaviour; no code changed.

defects.class: latent out-of-bounds copy / unchecked destination extent
defects.description: tls12_install_write and tls12_install_read copied cipher_key_len bytes into the fixed [u8; 32] enc_key/dec_key arrays. cipher_key_len is a pub field populated by either the TLS1.2 setup helper or the TLS1.3 schedule, and tls12_derive_key_block accepts key lengths up to 60, so the cross-function invariant key_len <= 32 was not expressed. Both installation helpers now refuse key_len > enc_key.len()/dec_key.len() before the copy and before the 2 * key_len arithmetic. Every reachable valid path is unchanged.

tls1_get_supported_groups returns &'static [u16] borrowed from the connection's element-counted supportedgroups list. The obligation not to use the slice after the list is freed/replaced or the connection is destroyed was stated only in a body comment; it is now in the # Safety section. The false-'static signature is retained and disclosed, not silently discharged.

defects.class: incomplete safety contract (implicit free of caller pointer)
defects.description: tls1_set_groups releases the caller's previous *grpext through OwnedBuf::adopt_plain_nullable. The # Safety section now requires *grpext to be NULL or an initialised, exclusively-owned block from the crate's CRYPTO_* malloc seam. Both current callers pass a context/connection member buffer that satisfies it.

documentation_corrections: src/ssl/statem/statem.rs: module divergence note for ossl_statem_send_fatal now matches the alert-writing body (M82-D1).
src/ssl/t1_lib.rs: tls1_get_supported_groups # Safety now names the borrow-duration obligation (M82-D3).
src/ssl/t1_lib.rs: tls1_set_groups # Safety now names the previous-*grpext ownership/release obligation (M82-D4).
not_discharged: All audited files are file-level audits, not SAFETY_DISCHARGED and not SAFE_COMPATIBLE.
tls1_get_supported_groups retains a &'static slice borrowed from connection-owned memory; this receipt discloses the caller obligation but does not tie the lifetime to the owner in the type system.
The TLS1.2 record-protection path is audited for the four reduced GCM suites of the non-resuming flow; CBC/CCM/ChaCha and MAC-then-encrypt remain unbuilt.
The reduced state machine does not build the authority's full message layer; only the fresh-connection and reduced flight-driver paths are reachable.
No Miri/ASan/Loom run was made: no owner, extent, aliasing or concurrency mechanism changed. No dudect/ctgrind claim is made.
src/store/store_meth.rs was not audited (deferred as a retained loader/callback boundary).
retained_obligations: src/ssl/statem/statem.rs: s is NULL or a live connection for the readers/drivers, and live for the mutators; the in_handshake increment/decrement pair must be balanced by the driver (C-level obligation, same as the authority).
src/ssl/t1_enc.rs: s is live, the cipher is set up, plain/ct are readable for their lengths, out is writable for the documented capacity, and content_type is writable.

src/ssl/t1_lib.rs: s/ctx/session are NULL or live; out-parameters are NULL or writable; the previous *grpext is NULL or an exclusively-owned CRYPTO_* block; the supportedgroups slice is used only while the connection owns it.

src/ssl/tls_depr.rs: ctx/e/ssl are live (NULL is accepted only where the authority's SSL_CONNECTION_FROM_SSL helper accepts it); the stored ENGINE remains borrowed and is never dereferenced in this reduced build.
src/ts/mod.rs: the error coordinate is a compile-time constant and msg is NULL or NUL-terminated.
src/ts/ts_lib.rs and src/ts/ts_req_print.rs: bio is live; object/algorithm/extension/request pointers are NULL only where the function documents a NULL arm; the extension stack's elements are live.
residuals: M82-R1: SSL_get1_builtin_sigalgs allocates the final string in one exact-size OwnedBuf block at the authority's line 2298, while the authority starts at SIGLEN_BUF_INCREMENT (100) and reallocs. The returned bytes and the OPENSSL_free hand-off agree; an allocator hook observes a different size. Compatibility-only, recorded rather than restructured.

M82-R2: the TLS1.2 master secret, key block and write/read keys live in the Ssl block owned by ssl_lib's SSL_free, and the P_hash scratch arrays (a/buf/h) are not explicitly cleansed. This is a cross-file secret-hygiene observation against AGENTS §5, not a new unsafe assumption; the owning destructor is outside this batch.
src/ssl/statem/statem.rs indexes and writes only plain scalar members; a corrupted hand_state is an authority-level value, not a memory extent.

src/ssl/t1_lib.rs SSL_get_shared_sigalgs' element fields are answered as NID_undef/0 because the array is never populated in this reduced build; the reachable answer is the authority's empty-state answer.

deferred.reason: store-loader/callback dispatch boundary (STORE method-store callbacks, CtxDestroy, provider up-ref/free, method-store lock/unlock, get/put/construct callbacks); a genuinely new retained boundary, kept in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt.

shared_boundary_files: src/ssl/ssl_lib.rs (Ssl owner: TLS1.2 secret fields, supportedgroups raw boundary, SSL_free)
src/ssl/tls13_enc.rs (shares hs_md_len/cipher_key_len and the transcript hash)
secret_bearing_buffers: t1_enc.rs derives the TLS1.2 master secret and key block into Ssl-owned fixed arrays (released by ssl_lib's SSL_free) and uses PRF scratch arrays that are not explicitly cleansed. ts_lib/ts_req_print print ASN.1 values through BIO and allocate only the BN_bn2hex string (freed plainly, as the authority's OPENSSL_free). No allocation, release coordinate or cleansing claim changed in this batch; no constant-time property is asserted.
